compiled_state.title: [test-merge-to-main-pr]: Lifecycle phases run under pr-success/pr-poll fixtures -> test file TIMEOUT (>90s CI)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

test-merge-to-main-pr.sh exceeds TEST_TIMEOUT=90 in CI.

After fixing git fetch refspec (explicit 'main:refs/remotes/origin/main'), the SHA verification in merge-to-main-pr.sh succeeds, causing pr-poll and pr-success tests to exercise the full lifecycle phases (version_bump, archive, ci_trigger sourced from merge-to-main-direct.sh). Previously these tests failed fast at the SHA check.

Measured: ~63s locally (test runner timeout: 60s local / 90s CI). CI is slower.

Prior fix attempts: git fetch refspec fix (b4790ce228) and test isolation fixes — none addressed the lifecycle phase execution time.

Fix options:
1. Add version.file_path= (empty) explicitly to fixture configs to prevent version_bump from running
2. Add MERGE_TO_MAIN_SKIP_LIFECYCLE=1 env var support 
3. Reduce lifecycle phase overhead in test fixtures

comments.body: Verified resolved: tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main.sh runs 69/69 PASS locally; main CI run 25411652624 (2026-05-06T01:31Z) shows Script Tests=success + Hook Tests=success. Functions _state_write_phase, _state_record_merge_sha defined in plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh and discovered by _extract_fn fallback. No further action needed.
